title: Possible Y-Axis Labels
text: Consider what metrics in machine learning might have a U-shaped relationship with the number of features or data points. Common metrics include error, variance, and bias.

title: Bias-Variance Tradeoff
text: In the context of the bias-variance tradeoff, both bias and variance can be related to the number of features. As the number of features increases, bias typically decreases and variance increases.
